success.description: Section4.3 invokes Section4.2's reasoning for the final four second-round difference tests from five plaintexts. Under that author heuristic, any fixed wrong complete key passes with probability2^-256. A union bound over all2^128-1 wrong AES128 keys gives the displayed conditional full-key output-correctness lower bound; it does not use the disputed2^16 candidate cap and needs no independence between different wrong keys. Correct-key retention and backward key expansion are part of the source complete-enumeration algorithm. This verifies model attribution/derivation, not actual-AES independence or an executed recovery experiment. Complete survivor enumeration is required; no tail bound proves it fits the source native2^34+2^16 estimated work. Existing candidate-count and S-box conversion conflicts remain. The symbolic bound is strictly below1 and is not rounded to100%.
